summary: Test cases follow setup, test, assert, idempotency test, assert, teardown; name non-assert tasks, use .yaml files, name target dirs after the module, and have main.yaml import the transport file, as in vyos_l3_interfaces.
questions: How should I structure a network module integration test?
What file extension do network test cases need?
How do I lay out tests for modules supporting multiple connections?

answer_card.title: Integration test structure
answer_card.answer_md:
- Flow: setup → test → assert → test again (idempotency) → assert → teardown.
- Name every non-assert task.
- Test case files must end in `.yaml`.
- Name `targets/` dirs after the module; `main.yaml` only references the transport:
```yaml
# targets/vyos_l3_interfaces/tasks/main.yaml
- import_tasks: cli.yaml
  tags: [cli]
```
